response: Goregaon (ward P/S) has billed Rs 4,349,997 of its Rs 4,800,000 monsoon road repair budget, or 90.6 percent, across 82 jobs. Only 61.0 percent of jobs met the promised repair time, and 20.7 percent were reopened within 30 days. The season may explain some of this: the city had 18 days of heavy or worse rain, and the ward has a low lying index of 0.5. Rs 497,073 was billed on roads under DLP, meaning the original contractor's warranty still covers them, so repairs there should cost the city nothing. This needs review. 6 jobs were priced more than 30 percent above the rate card and should be checked. Konkan Roadcon Pvt Ltd (synthetic) received the most spend. Citizens or ward officers can ask the ward office for the bills and site photos for WO25-00045 and WO25-00718, and whether either was on a DLP road.
